violation_type.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home with 3 or More Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1805)
violation_type.short_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home with 3 or More Caregivers
violation_type.typical_finding: At the time of inspection there were eleven children in care.  Three of the children were ages 12 months to 15 months, making the ratio for one caregiver to have a total of seven children in care.
